name: Moscow Mule
description: A refreshing vodka-based cocktail with ginger beer and lime, served in a copper mug.
instructions: Fill a copper mug with ice. Pour vodka and lime juice. Top with ginger beer. Stir gently. Garnish with lime wedge.

name: Mojito
description: A Cuban classic with rum, mint, lime, sugar, and soda water - perfectly refreshing.
instructions: Muddle mint and simple syrup gently. Add rum and lime juice. Fill with ice. Top with soda water. Stir and garnish with mint sprig.

name: Strawberry Mojito
description: A fruity twist on the classic mojito with fresh strawberries and mint.
instructions: Muddle strawberries and mint. Add rum, lime juice, and simple syrup. Fill with ice. Top with soda water. Stir and garnish with strawberry and mint.

name: Daiquiri
description: A simple yet elegant cocktail with rum, lime, and sugar - timeless and sophisticated.
instructions: Shake rum, lime juice, and simple syrup with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe glass. Serve immediately.

name: Espresso Martini
description: A sophisticated cocktail combining vodka, coffee liqueur, and fresh espresso.
instructions: Shake vodka, coffee liqueur, espresso, and simple syrup vigorously with ice. Strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with coffee beans.

name: Aperol Spritz
description: A light and bubbly Italian aperitif with Aperol, Prosecco, and soda water.
instructions: Fill a glass with ice. Add Aperol. Top with Prosecco and soda water. Stir gently. Garnish with orange slice.

name: Mimosa
description: A classic brunch cocktail made with Champagne and fresh orange juice.
instructions: Pour orange juice into a chilled flute glass. Top with Champagne. Stir gently. Garnish with orange slice.

name: Dark 'n Stormy
description: A powerful Bermudian cocktail with dark rum and spicy ginger beer.
instructions: Fill a glass with ice. Pour dark rum and lime juice. Top with ginger beer. Stir well. Garnish with lime wedge.

name: Paloma
description: A refreshing tequila cocktail with grapefruit juice, lime, and salt rim.
instructions: Rim a glass with salt. Fill with ice. Pour tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice, and simple syrup. Stir well. Garnish with grapefruit slice.

name: Cuba Libre
description: Simply rum and cola with lime - a timeless classic.
instructions: Fill a glass with ice. Pour rum and lime juice. Top with cola. Stir gently. Garnish with lime wedge.

name: Long Island Iced Tea
description: A powerful cocktail made with multiple spirits - handle with care!
instructions: Shake vodka, rum, gin, tequila, brandy, and sour mix with ice. Pour into a tall glass filled with ice. Top with cola. Stir well. Garnish with lemon slice.

name: Whiskey Sour
description: A balanced cocktail with whiskey, lemon juice, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Shake whiskey, lemon juice, and simple syrup with ice. Optional: add egg white for silky texture. Strain into a chilled coupe glass. Garnish with lemon wheel and cherry.

name: Cosmopolitan
description: An elegant cocktail made with vodka, cranberry juice, and triple sec.
instructions: Shake vodka, triple sec, cranberry juice, and lime juice with ice. Strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with lime wheel.
